IS : 9582 ( Part I ) - 1980 

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 

SINGLE-PHASE ELECTRIC MOTORS 

FOR DEFINITE PURPOSES 

PART I DOMESTIC LAUNDRY MACHINE MOTORS 

0. FOREWORD 

0.1 This Indian Standard ( Part I ) was adopted by the Indian Standards 
Institution on 28 August 1980, after the draft finalized by the Rotating 
Machinery Sectional Committee had been approved by the Electrotech- 
nical Division Council. 

0.2 The general requirements of single-phase electric motors are covered 
in IS : 996-1979* which is a necessary adjunct to this standard. This 
standard has been prepared with a view to cover the special requirements 
of single-phase motors for the specific application in domestic laundry 
machines. 

0.3 The requirements of domestic laundry machines are given separately 

inIS:6390-1971|. 

0.4 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this 
standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, 
expressing the result of a test, shall be rounded off in accordance with 
IS : 2-1960J. The number of significant places retained in the rounded 
off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this 
standard. 



1. SCOPE 

1.1 This standard (Part I) covers motors for domestic laundry machines 
which provides power for driving a domestic electric clothes washing 
machine, dryer or combination of washer and dryer. 

♦Specification for single-phase small ac and universal electric motors ( second revision ). 
tSpecification for domestic electric clothes washing machine ( non-automatic ). 
tRules for rounding off numerical values ( revised ). 



IS : 9582 ( Part I ) - 1980 

1.2 The motors covered by this standard mav have windings with 
Class A, Glass E or Class B insulations ( see IS : 1271-1958* ). 

2. TERMINOLOGY 

2.1 For the purpose of this standard, the definitions given in 2 of 
IS : 996- 1979| shall apply. 

3. TYPE OF MOTOR 

3.1 The motor for domestic laundry machines shall be one of the follow- 
ing types, and having windings with Class A, Class E, Class B or Class F 
insulation ( see IS : 1271-1958* ): 

a) Split phase motor, 

b) Capacitor start induction run motor, 

c) Capacitor start and capacitor run motor ( Two Value Capacitor 
Type ), 

d) Parmanent-split capacitor motor ( for dryers only ), 

e) Universal motor, and 

f ) ac series motors. 

4. VOLTAGE, FREQUENCY, OUTPUT AND SPEED RATINGS 

4.1 Voltage Rating — The provisions of 7,1 and D-2 of IS : 996-1979J 
shall apply. 

4.2 Frequency — The provisions of 7.2 and D-2 of IS : 996-1979| shall 
apply. 

4.3 Output Ratings — Preferred output ratings of the motor shall be 
125, 200, 250 and 370 watts. 

4.4 Speed — Motors shall be single speed or multi-speed pole changing 
type. Preferred slip shall be 7 percent. 

5. DIMENSIONS 

5.1 The provisions of 9 of IS : 996-1979f shall apply. 

6. TYPE OF ENCLOSURE 

6.1 The provisions of 4 of IS : 996-1979 shall apply f. 

♦Classification of insulating materials for electrical machinery and apparatus in 
relation to their thermal stability in service. 

tSpecification for single-phase small ac and universal electric motors ( second 
revision ). 



IS : 9582 ( Part I ) - 1980 

7. GENERAL CONSTRUCTION 

7.1 The requirements of 6 of IS : 996-1979* shall apply. 

8. GENERAL CHARACTERISTICS 

8.1 The provisions of 12 of IS : 996-1979* shall apply. 

9. TERMINAL MARKINGS 

9,1 The provisions of 13 of IS : 996=1979* shall apply. 

10. MARKING AND DIAGRAM OF CONNECTION 

10.1 The provisions of 14 of IS : 996-1979* shall apply except 14.1(a) 
which shall be substituted by: 

a) Reference to this Indian Standard, that is, Ref. ISS 9582 

11. TESTS 

11.1 The provisions of 15 of IS : 996-1979* shall apply. 



♦Specification for sing1e*phase small ac and universal electric motors ( mend 
revision ) 4
